title: Asian shares are mixed with tech stocks volatile, and oil falls on Trump's Russian sanctions waiver
description: Asian shares are mixed as the volatility in technology stocks persists. U.S. futures have edged higher ahead of another week of American corporate earnings. A sell-off of technology shares from Asia to Wall Street has recently put downward pressure on stock markets, as investor concerns grow over the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom. Oil prices have declined more than 1% after President Donald Trump’s decision to waive sweeping sanctions on Russia, including on Russian energy. On Friday, Wall Street’s benchmark S&P 500 declined 1.1%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.3%, and the technology-heavy Nasdaq composite sank 2.1%.

title: AI stocks lead a rebound on Wall Street as European markets drop following protests
description: Stocks in the artificial-intelligence industry are bouncing back on Wall Street, but the rest of the market and stocks worldwide are still shaky. The S&P 500 rose 0.5% Monday, coming off its worst week since June. The Nasdaq composite jumped 1%, but the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 76 points. Trading was also unsteady in stock markets around the world. Indexes dropped across Europe, including 1.6% in Paris following violent protests over the weekend that could put even more pressure on European bond markets. Yields cranked higher for bonds worldwide despite drops for oil prices.
content:
NEW YORK (AP) — Stocks in the artificial-intelligence industry are bouncing back on Wall Street Monday and recovering some of their steep losses from last week, but the rest of the market and stocks worldwide are still shaky.

title: HKU and Global Cybersecurity Alliance jointly establish Centre for AI and Cybersecurity Research
description: HONG KONG, Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The University of Hong Kong (HKU) and the Global Cybersecurity Alliance (GCSA) announced the joint establishment of the Centre for AI and Cybersecurity Research.
